item.title: My Month in Japan [VIDEO] - BATW
item.description: We packed so much into these three weeks, it still seems like a blur! Bullet trains, sumo wrestling, Mt. Fuji, cherry blossoms, museums for everything, multiple friends from the states… oh, and raw fish! Sushi time!

item.title: My Month in Chile [VIDEO] - BATW
item.description: We’ve now literally been around the world. Our final stop in South America got us back out of our comfort zone. It was cold, filled with graffiti and stray dogs, but ended with a total solar eclipse!
